reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Tracy Graham, founder and managing principal of Graham Allen Partners.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Tracy Graham, founder and managing principal of Graham Allen Partners, a private equity firm that specializes in acquiring and building technology-enabled businesses. In our conversation we discuss how Tracy ended up playing football at Notre Dame, the key lessons he learned from famed coach Lou Holtz. I hope you enjoy my fun conversation with Tracy.
